title: Genie ZeroOps is available in Beta
body: Genie ZeroOps is now available in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). It monitors jobs, pipelines, and tables in the background, detects failures and data quality issues, investigates the root cause, and proposes a fix. See [Get started with Genie ZeroOps](/aws/en/zeroops/get-started).
